## Purpose and runtime

AA Browser is a GPLv3 native Android Automotive/Android Auto-oriented WebView browser for Android 15+. It is a single Gradle Android app module, with WebView rendering, automotive resources/metadata, and XML-based native UI. Primary launch configuration is in `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`; build/runtime dependencies are defined by `app/build.gradle.kts`.

## Application entry and composition

`app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/MainActivity.kt` is the main browser host. It coordinates setup through `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/ui/MainActivitySetup.kt` and the primary screen structure in `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_main.xml`. Browser-related managers are separated by concern but are likely activity-owned collaborators rather than an independent backend/service layer.

## Browser rendering and navigation boundary

`app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/web/ConfiguredWebView.kt` configures the Android WebView and is the boundary between native app state/UI and arbitrary web content. `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/navigation/NavigationManager.kt` owns URL/navigation behavior, while `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/web/SslErrorHandlerHelper.kt` and `app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml` represent network and TLS/cleartext policy boundaries. Local rendering failures can use `app/src/main/assets/error.html`.

## Tab and session flow

`app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/tabs/TabManager.kt` manages multiple WebView/browser-tab instances, active-tab switching, closing, and restoration-related state. Native tab selection/display is mediated by `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/ui/adapters/TabAdapter.kt` and `app/src/main/res/layout/item_browser_tab.xml`. At launch, preferences determine whether the app opens a configured home page, restores tabs, resumes a page, or falls back to the start-page flow.

## Persistent user data and dashboard

`app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/data/BrowserPreferences.kt` is the persistence boundary for browser behavior and UI choices: home page, startup behavior, themes, scaling, user agent, and quick-action configuration. `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/bookmarks/BookmarkManager.kt` handles dashboard bookmarks; `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/data/SiteIconCache.kt` locally caches site icons. `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/startpage/StartPageManager.kt` builds the no-home-page dashboard, backed by start-page item layouts.

## Native UI, overlays, and settings

`app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/ui/BrowserUIManager.kt` controls browser chrome and user actions; `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/ui/OverlayManager.kt` manages transient panels/dialog-like overlays. Theme and display-scale application are centralized in `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/ui/ThemeManager.kt`. Settings are a separate activity/view surface at `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/settings/SettingsActivity.kt` and `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/settings/SettingsViews.kt`, writing preferences consumed by the main browser.

## Platform integrations and security-sensitive features

`app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/permissions/PermissionManager.kt` gates Android runtime permissions, including capabilities needed by web content. WebView bridges and certificate behavior are isolated in `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/web/SpeechRecognitionBridge.kt`, `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/web/ClientCertHandler.kt`, and `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/web/CryptoHelper.kt`; these are high-risk boundaries because they connect web-origin requests to device APIs or credentials.

## External services

The app loads arbitrary user-requested websites through Android WebView, including media/DRM support provided by the platform WebView stack. `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/analytics/UmamiTracker.kt` sends limited anonymous app-open/version telemetry to a self-hosted Umami instance, explicitly separate from browser URL/content handling. Sponsor/start-page data is represented by `app/src/main/java/com/kododake/aabrowser/startpage/SponsorsManager.kt`.
